Process

Clear steps, no surprises

You always know what's happening, what it costs and what comes next.

  1. 01

    Discovery call

    A free 30-minute call. We talk about your goals, current setup and what success looks like.

  2. 02

    Plan & estimate

    You get a written scope, timeline and fixed or hourly price. No hidden costs.

  3. 03

    Build in iterations

    Weekly demos on a live preview link. You give feedback early, while changes are cheap.

  4. 04

    Launch & support

    Deployment, monitoring and documentation. We stay with you for fixes and the next features.

About us

A focused team with senior experience and full responsibility

For more than six years we have been building web products for startups, agencies and small businesses. You talk directly to the engineers who write your code: no layers of managers, no lost requirements.

Our core stack is Next.js on the frontend, AdonisJS on the backend and PostgreSQL for data. It lets us move fast while keeping the codebase clean and easy to hand over.

  • Honest estimates and regular updates

FAQ

Common questions

How much does a project cost?

It depends on scope. Small business websites start from a fixed price; larger products are estimated after the discovery call. You always get a written estimate before any work starts.

Can you take over a project another developer or agency started?

Yes, it's one of our core services. We start with a short code audit, tell you honestly what state it's in, and propose a plan to stabilize and continue it.

Do you work with technologies other than Next.js and Adonis?

Yes. For support and optimization we work with most JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js stacks and common SQL databases. For new builds we recommend our core stack because it is fast to develop and easy to maintain.

What happens after launch?

You can choose a monthly support plan (fixes, updates, small features) or contact us as needed. Either way, you own everything and get documentation for it.
